title: Analytical Procedures (Related Substances SM1)[Purity][CP-4]
description: Core quality information (2.3.3.AP) for Analytical Procedures (Related Substances SM1)[Purity][CP-4].

action.title: Column
action.description: Silica C18 3,5 µm 250x4.6 mm or equivalent

action.title: Test solution
action.description: Approximately 1.0 mg/ml of sample to be examined in diluent.

action.title: Reference solution
action.description: Approximately 0.001 mg/mg of CP-9 standard in diluent

action.title: System Suitability Criteria
action.description: Resolution NLT 1.5 Reproducibility (n=6) < 10 %                                               RSD of  ≤ 1% for n≥ 5 is desirable.

action.title: Calculation
action.description: The specified and unspecified degradation products are calculated against CP-4 in the reference solution with the corresponding Response correction factor (RF). IWP =  integration value of the by-product or degradation product in the test solution IWR =  integration value of the by-product or degradation product in the reference solution PR =   initial concentration of the reference substance [mg/mL] PP =   initial concentration of the substance [mg/mL] C =     content of the reference substance, in %
